name: clock_getres
synopsis: int clock_getres(clockid_t clockid, struct timespec *_Nullable res);
description: The clock_getres() function retrieves the resolution (precision) of the specified clock. If the res pointer is not NULL, it stores the resolution in the provided struct timespec. The resolution is implementation-dependent and cannot be configured by a process.

parameters.name: clockid
parameters.description: Identifier of the clock for which to retrieve the resolution.

parameters.name: res
parameters.description: Pointer to a timespec structure to store the resolution, or NULL if not needed.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and sets errno to indicate the error

errors.description: res points outside the accessible address space.
The hot-pluggable device represented by a dynamic clockid has disappeared.
